name: Surgical redline and memo for the vendor SaaS MSA

brief.objective: Redline Northwind's MSA for the approved issues and write the negotiation memo for Harborlight's attorney.

notes: Starts from evals/fixtures/m3_msa_workspace: the MSA plus the approved m2 issue list (issues.json/md/csv and review notes, as record_issues wrote them). Expect minimal tracked changes (e.g. 'three (3) months' to 'twelve (12) months', 'paid' to 'paid or payable', 'ninety (90)' to 'thirty (30)'), carve-out language added to 9.3 rather than a rewritten clause, comment-only ops where facts are missing, and no edits outside approved issues; the approved issue list must stay unchanged. The memo must rank the escalated items first and must not claim market standards the playbook does not state.
